ops.body:
CORRECTION (2026-08-04): this task's original premise was WRONG, and the index
drop it was written to guard has been REVERTED.

The premise said dropping an index pre-ship "costs nothing today" because
v0.21 is unshipped. That conflates the *binary's* schema being unshipped with
*no database in the field carrying the old schema*. Shipped 0.64.x databases
are exactly what v0.21 upgrades — §B's contract is same-file adoption — so the
old schema is shipped in the only place that matters.

What the drop actually broke, verified end to end:

1. `git show v0.64.9:internal/store/store.go` carries both index lines
   (:380, :384), and `verifySchema` is hash-exact — `user_version` plus
   `exactSchemaHash()` compared against `schemaHash(db)` over every
   sql-bearing `sqlite_schema` row. Named indexes are sql-bearing, so they are
   inside the fingerprint.
2. `git diff v0.64.9..origin/main -- internal/store/` is EMPTY, so a real
   0.64.9 machine's database fingerprint equals main's schema exactly.
3. Dropping the indexes changed the new binary's expected fingerprint while
   every shipped database still carried them → `ErrSchemaMismatch` on open.
4. `ErrSchemaMismatch` has zero non-test consumers — no archive, no rebuild,
   no recovery tooling. The store fails to open, the daemon dies before
   Serve/Start/ClaimForeignLanes, and §B adoption never runs. That is the
   0896d69 failure mode exactly.

The golden fixtures structurally cannot catch this: they open fresh databases
that already carry the new schema.

RESOLUTION: option A — both `CREATE INDEX` lines restored, fingerprint parity
with v0.64.9 preserved. The three `*OwnedBy` wrappers stay deleted; that half
of the ruling was sound and is unaffected. The indexes are write-side-only
cost on tables holding at most one row per account (account_mutations.account_id
is NOT NULL UNIQUE; credential_operations.account_id is INTEGER PRIMARY KEY),
so carrying them is close to free.

The indexes come out at a REAL schema epoch, when a migration path exists
anyway — see 0896d69. Not before.

REUSABLE RULE: a pre-ship schema change is free only when no database in the
field carries the old schema. Check `git diff <last-tag>..HEAD -- <store dir>`
and whether the schema check is fingerprint-exact before assuming otherwise.

This gate's original tripwire (poll handler needing owned paging) was also
checked against the landed handler and does NOT trip: internal/daemon has zero
`owner_record`/`OwnedBy` references, and the replay cursor pages terminal
output chunks (accountterminal.TerminalOutputCursor), not account_mutations
rows.
